data.rationale: The proposal captures the right goal (Find a Park, filter by Activity/Topic dropdown checkboxes, Search) but skips the "Search by Activity or Topic" click, treats activity and topic as separate parameters instead of filter_type/filter_values, adds an unneeded scroll/read step, and leaves the state selection vague, so an automation would need guesswork.
